github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Title: `<type>: <summary>` with type feat, fix, chore, docs or test, in imperative mood, describing only what this commit changes. Add a body only when the reason for the change isn't obvious from the diff, and explain why rather than what.

github.copilot.chat.pullRequestDescripti.text: Title: `<type>: <summary>` with type feat, fix, chore, docs or test. Description: what changed, why, and how it was verified, as short bullets. Describe the PR's final state, not the sequence of commits.
